name: Second direct CNN PPO update on 16 new frozen behavior credits per original title
frozen: Common controller seed within physical host on original Normal credits; title-specific stocks; no automatic shooting/bombing or geometric control.
interpretation: Compare successive on-policy updates on a new seed block. Same reward and KL bound as the first camera PPO update.
reward_change: Only TH13 receives +0.25 once at each of the 25th/50th/75th percentiles of maximum Stage 1 script ticks on eight prior SFT training credits. Same 48 PPO1 original credits, action samples, optimizer seed, epochs, LR and starting weights as plain PPO2.
test: Fresh TH13 held original credits on the same machine, counterbalanced by seed. Primary Stage 2 and Stage 1 native ticks; secondary Bomb stock.
